CustomField.description: THIS DOES NOT REFER TO THE USERS' REWARD POINTS BALANCE. This field allows you to manually add points to a customer's Reel Rewards account. If the field value is 0 and you change it to 10, 10 points will be added to the user's existing point balance.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field allows you to manually add points to a customer's Reel Rewards account.
CustomField.label: OCC_RewardsValue (Contact)
